instruction: Locate and access the check-in section on the United Airlines site.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the check-in page on United Airlines website. Similar to the original task (baggage fee calculator), this is a simple navigation task requiring the agent to find and click through to a common airline service page. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the pattern 'united.com/en/us/checkin'. No custom functions needed as we reuse the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info() successfully extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and Chrome via Playwright
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match() properly performs regex pattern matching on the URL, handles both string and dict result formats
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with 'url' field, metric extracts and processes it correctly
Expected value is semantically correct: pattern 'united.com/en/us/checkin' accurately represents the United Airlines check-in page URL
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies that the check-in page is open in the active tab, which fully satisfies the instruction requirement
Practical and feasible: both getter and metric will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling and edge case coverage
